# `aitbc trade search`

Search trading offers with a query.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade search [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | text | — | no | Search query text |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Filter by chain ID |
| `--service-type` | text | — | no | Filter by service type |
| `--min-price` | float | — | no | Minimum price filter |
| `--max-price` | float | — | no | Maximum price filter |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Max results |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade search
```
